integrity: Analytic global argument from bounded limsup, exact tracking equation and a stable-filter lemma; symbolic identities and finite illustrations independently executed; scientific priority remains open to independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic two-patch ODE, fixed e=B, m>=1/H, strictly positive finite initial data; asymptotic limits not uniform near threshold. Qualitative local classification and cubic normal form are prior art.
title: Universal extinction-rate transition at a doubly critical two-patch Allee threshold
